content.thinking: A test-script bug: I used Python `null` instead of `None`. Let me fix that.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='/app/tmp/test_invalid.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('[5], [null], [["::1"]]', '[5], [None], [["::1"]]')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
time python3 /app/tmp/test_invalid.py
